name: plan_check
description: Set one item of the plan: `doing` when you start it, `done` when it is finished, `dropped` when it is no longer needed (say why in `note`), `pending` to put it back. `id` is the number shown before the item. `note` replaces the item's note; an empty `note` clears it, and leaving it out keeps it. With no arguments the plan comes back unchanged, to read it again. Returns the whole plan.

id.description: The number shown before the item

note.description: Why, or where the work is; empty clears the note
